inputs: Explicit mode, UTF-8 input file, literal output directory
behaviors.completion: Selected output written exclusively and exact bytes read back; input preserved. Failure only complete when failure.json read back.
outputs: count.json: object with nonempty_lines integer in literal output directory; failure.json for missing/invalid UTF-8 input
prerequisites: Python 3 standard library; input is regular file; output directory creatable/writable; no count.json, lines.txt or failure.json already present
effects: Read input only; create chosen directory and one result or failure file exclusively
behaviors.failure: Missing or invalid UTF-8 input produces FAILED JSON with original input argument; output errors, collisions or failed readback report incomplete delivery without redirecting outputs.
behaviors.recovery: Retain partial outputs after interrupted writes. Never overwrite or automatically remove them. User selects a fresh directory or resolves existing outputs before retry. No child processes.
